scripts.text:
[Maram]
You've arrived, adventurer!
Thank you for coming all the way here.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你終於來了，冒險者！
謝謝你大老遠跑過來。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
It seems like this is the real deal after all. The security here is different from what it has been so far....
Let's be careful not to be caught by the guards and explore the inside.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
看來這次是真的了。這裡的安保措施和之前大不相同……
我們要小心別被衛兵發現，然後探索內部。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Try to move away from the security guard's line of sight as much as possible.
If you get caught, you might be attacked, so if you can't break through, we'll meet again here.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
儘量避開保安的視線。
如果被發現了，可能會遭到攻擊，如果無法突破，我們就在這裡再會吧。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Let's try to go in while avoiding the guard tower as much as possible.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
讓我們儘量避開中央塔，嘗試進去吧。

scripts.text: ^FF0000Caution : If you perform arbitrary processing within the dungeon, such as monster taming, it will not be considered normal progress.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000注意：如果在地下城內進行馴服魔物等任意操作，將不被視為正常進度。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maram]
When the application is complete, talk to me again and select ^0000CD{0} entry^000000
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
申請完成後，請再次與我交談並選擇^0000CD{0}入口^000000

scripts.text:
[Maram]
It seems like you haven't created the dungeon yet. Please check again in a moment.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
看起來你還沒有建立地下城。請稍後再試。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
^ff0000Only a member of the party can enter the Memorial Dungeon.^000000
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
^ff0000只有隊伍成員才能進入記憶地下城。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Be careful and explore inside.
From what I heard from Dandelion earlier, there aren't many people, but there are watchtowers here and there that monitor a fairly wide area.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
請小心探索內部。
根據之前蒲公英告訴我的，這裡人不多，但到處都有監視範圍很廣的瞭望塔。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
If you get caught by the watchtower, soldiers will appear, so be careful not to get caught.
Well, if you find anything, please contact me!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
如果被瞭望塔發現，士兵會出現，所以請小心別被抓住。
嗯，如果你發現什麼，請聯絡我！
